**The review endpoint** (`chronicler/review/core.py`) writes `{projects, review_rulings, threads}` -- `review_queue` is not in that set. `ARCHITECTURE.md` §5 names `review_queue` as the endpoint's write target; the tree disagrees (finding A4, `investigation/2026-08-02_architecture-drift_claude_2-response.md`).

## 5. Schema shape

### `chronicler/pipeline/schema.sql` -- 8 table(s)

- **attachments**: attachment_id PK, message_id, filename, turn_hash, file_path, mime, extracted_content
- **ingestion_log**: batch_id PK, source, account, file_hash, imported_at, rows_new, rows_changed, rows_skipped, parser_version
- **link_evidence**: evidence_id PK, thread_id, project, signal, weight, detail, produced_at, producer_version
- **messages**: message_id PK, thread_id, seq, role, content, created_at, source_turn_hash
- **projects**: project_id PK, name, repo_folder_path, source_system_id
- **review_queue**: item_id PK, type, thread_id, candidate_thread_id, confidence, status, note, created_at, resolved_at, candidate_project, rival_project
- **review_rulings**: item_id PK, thread_id, candidate_project, verdict, ruled_at
- **threads**: thread_id PK, source, account, title, created_at, updated_at, gem_name, is_custom_gem, status, closed_at, project_link, project_confidence, review_status, raw_ref, parser_version, substantive, review_note, suggested_close, tags, link_evidence_ids

### `chronicler/pipeline/schema_frozen.sql` -- 11 table(s)

- **attachments**: attachment_id PK, message_id, filename, turn_hash, file_path, mime, extracted_content
- **ingestion_log**: batch_id PK, source, account, file_hash, imported_at, rows_new, rows_changed, rows_skipped, parser_version
- **link_evidence**: evidence_id PK, thread_id, project, signal, weight, detail, produced_at, producer_version
- **messages**: message_id PK, thread_id, seq, role, content, created_at, source_turn_hash
- **meta**: key PK, value
- **path_scan_log**: id PK, scanned_through, updated_at
- **projects**: project_id PK, name, repo_folder_path, source_system_id
- **render_log**: thread_id PK, rendered_fields, rendered_at
- **review_queue**: item_id PK, type, thread_id, candidate_thread_id, confidence, status, note, created_at, resolved_at, candidate_project, rival_project
- **review_rulings**: item_id PK, thread_id, candidate_project, verdict, ruled_at
- **threads**: thread_id PK, source, account, title, created_at, updated_at, gem_name, is_custom_gem, status, closed_at, project_link, project_confidence, review_status, raw_ref, parser_version, review_note, suggested_close, tags, link_evidence_ids, substantive

### Delta (`schema_frozen.sql` vs `schema.sql`)

- only in `schema_frozen.sql`: meta, path_scan_log, render_log
- only in `schema.sql`: (none)

`render_log` is present in `schema_frozen.sql` and absent from `schema.sql` -- a from-scratch build (`db.py` builds from `schema.sql`) has no `render_log` table until `render_md.py` creates it on first use (finding A12, `investigation/2026-08-02_architecture-drift_claude_2-response.md`).
